question_text:
Given the following tables:

Table 1: Tax Collection by City (in millions of pesos)
| City | Tax Collection |
|------|----------------|
| City A | 50 |
| City B | 30 |
| City C | 20 |

Table 2: Population Density by City (persons per sq km)
| City | Population Density |
|------|-------------------|
| City A | 1,000 |
| City B | 800 |
| City C | 500 |

Which city has the highest tax collection per person (assuming area is the same for all cities)?
